name: Essa
appearance: Weathered, blind in one eye, a net in her lap.
wants: The guild kept neutral, and good gossip.
does_not_want: Being left out of the news.
dreams: To retire the most respected elder in Caelrun, having written nothing down.
knows: Who owes whom, across the village.
offers: Nets, rope, and information traded fairly.
family: Widowed; grown children fish for other families.
anecdotes: Lost her eye to a snapped line in a storm and mended the net before she let anyone look at her.
